name: Retina Paints Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Retina Paints Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and selling of Paints[1]
keyPoints:
Product & Brands:
RPL provides high-quality paint solutions from durable exterior paints to vibrant 
interior option:
a) Interior Emulsions:[1]
Retina Royal Vogue, Retina Glow Premium,
Retina Glow Advanced
b) Primers:[2]
Retina Eco Damp, Retina Eco Advanced, 
Retina Jet Advanced, Retina X – Gen+
c) Exterior Emulsions:[3]
Retina Weather Expert, Retina Expo Ultimax, 
Retina Expo Advanced
d) Emulsion /Distempers:[4]
Retina Zing+, Retina Spark, Retina Eye

cons: Stock is trading at 2.73 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 4.41% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 419 days.
